capabilities.notes: Folder access depends on the desktop permission granted by the user.
MCP availability is product/version dependent; verify before promising a server.
Portable skills can be supplied when the Cowork build supports Agent Skills.
Claude Code settings hooks are not assumed in Cowork.
The desktop session lifecycle is client-owned.
Dex's local scheduler is not provided by Cowork.
Use Agent Plugins v1 only if the installed client advertises it.

limitations: Cowork is not treated as Claude Code; hooks and settings.json are not portable assumptions.
name: Claude Cowork
summary: Desktop Cowork companion with skills and interactive work; local hooks and scheduling are not assumed.
